notificationIntroBody: Android creates a service notification during processing. Enable its display to see progress and cancel the task when the app is in the background.
title: Pixora

stages.preparing_image: We prepare a copy of your image. The original file does not change.
stages.checking_device: We select a processing method for your phone.
stages.upscaling: We enlarge the image one part at a time.
stages.building_result: We assemble the image at the selected size.
stages.writing_result: We write the result to your phone.

prepareNote: First, we reduce a copy of your image. This helps your phone process the image.
cpu: CPU processing may take several minutes.
long: Processing continues. Speed depends on your device.
alpha: JPEG replaces transparency with a white background.
unsaved: The unsaved result will be removed from the app. Your original stays unchanged.
notificationBody: Android creates a service notification during processing. Turn on its display to see progress and cancel in the background. Refusing does not stop processing.
interrupted: Processing was interrupted. You can start again.
deleteBody: Working files will be deleted. Saved images in your gallery will stay.
privacyBody: Photos and AI processing stay on your phone. Firebase receives usage information and error reports. These do not include photos, file locations, email addresses or feedback text. You can turn off analytics and error reports separately in Settings. With internet access, the app checks which processing modes are available. Offline, it uses the last settings, or enables all modes if it has never connected.
unavailableBody: Android 10+, ARM64, and a 4 GB class device are required.
modelInvalid: AI model unavailable. Reinstall the APK.
comparisonHelp: Drag the divider or use the Before and After buttons.

errors.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Supported: JPEG, PNG and static WebP.
errors.ANIMATED_IMAGE: Choose a still image. Animation is not supported.
errors.DIMENSIONS_TOO_LARGE: Image is too large: maximum 50 million pixels and 20,000 px per side.
errors.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: File is unavailable. Choose it again.
errors.DECODE_FAILED: Cannot read this image. Try another file.
errors.DEVICE_UNSUPPORTED: Requires Android 10+, ARM64 and a 4 GB class device.
errors.MODEL_INVALID: Model is missing or damaged. Reinstall the APK.
errors.LOW_STORAGE: Not enough space. Free at least 256 MiB and try again.
errors.LOW_MEMORY: Not enough memory. Close other apps and try again.
errors.INFERENCE_FAILED: Processing failed. Try again or choose another file.
errors.SERVICE_START_FAILED: Could not start processing. Return to the app and try again.
errors.TIME_LIMIT: The 30-minute processing limit was reached. You can try again.
errors.INTERRUPTED: Processing was interrupted. Start it again.
errors.EXPORT_FAILED: Could not save or open the file. Your result stays in the app.
errors.SHARE_FAILED: Could not share the file. Your result stays in the app.
errors.BUSY: Wait for completion or cancel the current task.
errors.PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE: Processing modes are temporarily unavailable. You can still save your last result.

backgroundBody: Processing continues in the background. Follow progress in the notification.
returnBody: You can leave the app and return later.

howSections.learnBody: The AI model was trained on example images. It learned to recognise lines, edges and textures.
howSections.copyBody: The model uses what it learned to upscale your image. 2× or 4× applies to the width and height.
howSections.detailBody: Small details can differ from the original. Compare the images before you save.

photoHint: Choose an image to enlarge and improve its details.
pngNote: PNG keeps details and transparency. Files can be larger.
jpegNote: JPEG makes smaller files for sharing. It can change fine details.
webpNote: WebP keeps details and transparency in a compact file. Some older apps cannot open it.
cacheHelpBody: We keep the selected image and the last result so you can return to them. Temporary copies help with sharing. Your saved pictures are separate.
cacheLimitNote: The limit applies when the app restarts. The current image stays available until then. Processing can temporarily use more space. Saved pictures and AI models are not included.
emailNote: We will reply to this address.
feedbackPrivacy: Only your email, message, optional rating and app version are sent. Images stay on your device.
feedbackUnavailable: Feedback is not available yet. The support service needs to be connected.
feedbackError: Could not send feedback. Your text is still here. Please try again.
rateBody: Your image is saved. You can send us feedback or leave an honest review in Google Play.
photoDesc: For photos and textured images. Choose detail or shorter processing.
artDesc: For drawings and cartoons. These models focus on lines and flat colors.
pixelDesc: Keeps the pixel grid with exact scaling. No AI or new details.
aspectBody: This image is unusually narrow. The preview may be hard to compare, and AI may change small details. You can continue.

lite.title: Lite
lite.note: A small model for shorter processing.

details.title: Details
details.note: Adds gentle definition to fine edges.

balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.note: Balances AI details with the source.

speedNote: Less time. Small details may be simpler.
sameInput: This small image uses the same AI input at both speeds.
profilesUnavailable: Processing modes are temporarily unavailable. You can still save your last result.
profileChanged: The selected mode is unavailable. Another mode was selected.
telemetryIntro: Photos are processed on your phone. The app sends usage and error information to help us improve it.
analyticsBody: Which features are used. Photos and feedback are not included.
crashesBody: Helps us find crashes. Photos and feedback are not included.
